items.description:

##Warnings)##

Strong winds developing later.

West or SW 3 or 4, backing South through this morning and afternoon, then backing and increasing SE 4 or 5 later in the evening. Further increasing SE 5 or 6 overnight.


##State of sea)##

##Weather)##

Fair.


##Visibility)##

Good.


##Temperature##

15°C

Strong winds.
